gloss: small accessory case; trinket box; catch-all container

definitions.gloss: small accessory case; trinket box; catch-all container
definitions.explanation: A container, pouch, or box designed to hold small personal items such as keys, coins, stationery, or accessories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小物|こもの}{入|い}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れてある→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The keys are in the trinket box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小物|こもの}{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a leather accessory case for my birthday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小物|こもの}{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧や⟦{定期券|ていきけん}→定期券：01064_teikiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくさなくて⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: If you keep a catch-all by the entrance, you won't lose your keys or commuter pass.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{小物|こもの}→小物：17814_komono⟧ (small items; accessories) + ⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (container; holder). Refers to any container designed for organizing small personal belongings. Can range from a simple tray on a desk to a zippered pouch in a bag.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小物|こもの}{入|い}れ: leather accessory case
- {小物|こもの}{入|い}れ⟦ポーチ→ポーチ：09488_poochi⟧: small accessory pouch
- {小物|こもの}{入|い}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in the catch-all

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ポーチ→ポーチ：09488_poochi⟧: pouch — a loanword often used for cosmetic or travel pouches
- {小物|こもの}{入|い}れ{箱|ばこ}: small items box — specifically a box rather than a pouch or tray
- ⟦{筆|ふで}{箱|ばこ}→筆箱：08263_fudebako⟧: pencil case — specifically for writing implements
